contract: Pure supplied-profile composition entry derives deficit from hydraulic_view water_content and checked root-zone accounting, then delegates selection to the existing scheduled evaluator. Existing irrigation_state_t is the only candidate state. Geometry is required eagerly for an eligible new DCS1 selection (even if timing later does not trigger); active events, DCS2 and ineligible selections delegate without consuming profile data. Caller retains calendar, parameter and committed-state authority.
validation: Check allocated hydraulic water content and matching active-node count before profile access. Invalid profile returns zero flux and unchanged candidate with explicit invalid-parameters status. Preserve checked-profile availability bounds and source arithmetic.
gate: Extend existing 200000 checked-deficit composition vectors to compare the new entry with independently prepared requests at O0/O2; preserve existing scheduled and root-zone suites.
non_claims: This adds callable process composition, not production driver wiring, accepted soil mass, solute transport, disk restart or canonical admission.
